moments.action: Main titles over a high-school parking lot: a blonde girl in a floral top perches on a red convertible, the camera lingering on her bare legs, until she looks up from her phone straight to camera.
Across the lot the dark-haired young man in the navy tee stands by a beige muscle car; the crowd parts and a pack of boys in purple football jerseys walks over, ending in a line facing camera.
The blonde turns on the car and smiles over her shoulder; the dark-haired young man smiles back across the lot. The last wide reveals him watching her from behind as the blond jock in #13 closes in.
She glances away and the blond jock in the #13 jersey scowls; the dark-haired man ducks in through his car window. By the last shots the jock has planted himself beside her on the convertible.
A standoff across the parked cars: the jock in #13 talks at the dark-haired man, who smirks back. More jerseys mass behind the convertible, and by the end the jock is leaning in, mid-insult.
The blonde slides off the convertible and stands as the jocks line up shoulder to shoulder; the dark-haired man answers loudly over a car roof. The jock's face hardens while she turns away laughing.
The beige muscle car and the red convertible stage nose-out with the crowd between them, then launch - a tyre crushing scattered glass - as the jock in #13 throws his arms up to start them.

An aerial shows the whole lot packed with spectators and parked cars; the dark-haired man grins behind the wheel. The last held shot settles on his cream car's windshield, smashed through with a hole.
The jerseys stand in a row and the dark-haired man faces them alone; they advance across the asphalt, and he walks back toward his cream car as the crowd closes into a ring around them.
Face-off in close-up: the dark-haired man holds a small smile while the blond jock scowls, teammates flanking him. The camera finally whip-pans off their faces into the packed crowd.
The blonde watches from inside the crowd; the jock and the dark-haired man trade words in tight close-up, and by the last shot the students around them have broken into open shouting.
